newFeatures.title: Excel Add-in v0.4.0
description: The new version `v0.4.0` of the _Excel Add-in_ is available, and it supports the new **Business Glossary**: terms can now be pulled, enriched, and pushed from an Excel worksheet.
Check the [changelog](/docs/products/data_catalog/excel_add_in/changelog) for the full list of changes.

bugFixes.title: Excel Add-in v0.4.1
description: The new version `v0.4.1` of the _Excel Add-in_ is available!
The pull operation no longer fails with a worksheet error when an option custom property has a long or empty list of options.
Check the [changelog](/docs/products/data_catalog/excel_add_in/changelog) for the full list of changes.

newFeatures.title: Custom Fields
description: Items can now be enriched with **Custom Fields**: typed, validated metadata that extends an Item Type without modifying its native schema — ideal for business or governance attributes that aren't covered out of the box. See the [Custom Fields documentation](/docs/products/catalog/basic-concepts/custom-fields) for the full workflow.

newFeatures.title: LLM Description for Item Types
description: Item Type Definitions can now carry an **LLM Description**, a natural-language description written for AI agents and LLMs that explains what the items of the type represent and how to use their fields. See the [Item Types documentation](/docs/products/catalog/basic-concepts/item-types#llm-description).

newFeatures.title: Governance templates
description: Rules, scorecards, and campaigns can now be saved as **templates** shared with all the users of the tenant. Templates cannot be edited or deleted, but their parameters can be changed every time they are used. See [Rules](/docs/products/catalog/basic-concepts/evaluation-criteria#templates), [Scorecards](/docs/products/catalog/basic-concepts/scorecards#templates), and [Campaigns](/docs/products/catalog/basic-concepts/campaigns#templates).

improvements.title: User Profile page
description: Every user now has a [Profile page](/docs/products/mia-platform-suite/rbac-management#profile) listing their tenants, groups, and effective roles.

improvements.title: Catalog MCP configuration
description: The configuration of the Catalog MCP Server for VS Code and Claude Code can now be copied directly from the left sidebar of the Catalog App. See the [Catalog MCP Server documentation](/docs/products/catalog/usage/catalog-mcp).

newFeatures.title: AI Gateway & MCP Gateway
description: AI Foundry becomes a governed control plane for models and AI tools: the **AI Gateway** is a single proxy for LLM traffic with cost tracking, caching, guardrails/policies, and observability, while **MCP Federation** unifies multiple MCP servers behind one Foundry-governed endpoint with a federated registry and centralized discovery.

newFeatures.title: Playbook assistant
description: A new assistant helps you create a playbook starting from a template to fill in with your use case. See the [Playbook documentation](/docs/products/ai-foundry/basic-concepts/playbook#playbook-assistant).

newFeatures.title: MCP prompts and resources
description: MCP servers can now expose **prompts** and **resources** to agents, in addition to tools. See the [MCP Server documentation](/docs/products/ai-foundry/basic-concepts/mcp-server#prompts-and-resources).

improvements.title: Mia AI Runtime and app built-in tools
description: Internal tools such as `web_search` are now provided by the **Mia AI Runtime** and must be enabled explicitly on each agent. Built-in tools of Claude Code, VS Code, and JetBrains are also available. See the [Tool documentation](/docs/products/ai-foundry/basic-concepts/tool).

improvements.title: MCP server and CLI setup
description: The setup instructions for the AI Foundry MCP server and CLI can now be copied from the left sidebar. See [Third-party integrations](/docs/products/ai-foundry/connections/third-party-integrations#connect-the-ai-foundry-mcp-server-and-cli).

improvements.title: Improved yaml schema validation for Helm charts
description: The chart editor of Charts section in Design Area now validates `values.yaml` live against each chart's schema using the official `monaco-yaml` engine — including subchart dependencies from `Chart.yaml` — replacing the previous custom validation logic.

improvements.title: Form-based editing for Infrastructure Resources
description: Infrastructure Resources created from a Marketplace item that defines a JSON schema now keep their **form** after creation: the JSON schema of the selected item version is applied to validate the resource not only when it is first added, but also on every subsequent edit.

You can still switch to the YAML editor for more advanced changes; if the manifest no longer matches the JSON schema of the item version, switching back to the form is disabled. Once a resource is detached from the Marketplace, only the YAML editor is available.
Check the [Infrastructure Resources documentation](/docs/products/console/design-your-projects/custom-resources/#update-an-infrastructure-resource) for more details.

improvements.title: Helm charts in Project Blueprint templates
description: Helm charts defined in the `charts` property of a Project Blueprint template are now saved in the configuration of the new Project when it is created. This applies only to Projects with the enhanced workflow.

bugFixes: Fixed an issue where, in Projects with the Enhanced Workflow using Azure DevOps, GitLab, or Bitbucket pipelines, the Deploy section showed the pipeline branch (for example `master`) as the last deployed revision instead of the revision or version actually deployed.

Fixed an issue where, in Projects with the Enhanced Workflow and an external Orchestrator Generator, the comparison with the last deployment showed every file as deleted and added again, hiding the actual differences. Files are now matched again and the comparison shows only the real content changes.

bugFixes.title: Farm Data v0.6.4
description: The new version `v0.6.4` of _Farm Data_ is available!
Compound index keys are now sorted, preventing the creation of duplicate MongoDB indexes.
Check the [changelog](/docs/products/fast_data_v2/farm_data/changelog) for the full list of changes.

bugFixes.title: Mongezium v0.5.1
description: The new version `v0.5.1` of _Mongezium_ is available!
Mongezium now selects the newest resume token across all the partitions of a topic.
Check the [changelog](/docs/products/fast_data_v2/mongezium_cdc/changelog) for the full list of changes.

newFeatures.title: Notification Manager Service v2.6.1
description: The new versions `v2.6.1`, `v2.6.0` and `v2.5.0` of the _Notification Manager Service_ are available!
`v2.5.0` adds support for **multiple Firebase credentials**, to send push notifications to multiple apps.
`v2.6.0` adds support for **multiple device tokens per user** via the `deviceTokens` field, to send push notifications to multiple devices.
`v2.6.1` fixes the custom handler utility functions, which can now use the new `deviceTokens` field when sending push notifications to multiple devices.
Check the [changelog](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/notification-manager-service/changelog) for the full list of changes.

improvements.title: Authentication Service v3.14.2
description: The new version `v3.14.2` of the _Authentication Service_ is available!
This release adds **TLS encryption management** in the Redis Sentinel configuration.
It also fixes the `/userinfo` response, which again always includes the `groups` field, restoring the pre-3.13.0 contract.
Check the [changelog](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/authentication-service/changelog) for the full list of changes.

improvements.title: Client Credentials v3.5.1
description: The new version `v3.5.1` of the _Client Credentials_ service is available!
This release adds **TLS encryption management** in the Redis Sentinel configuration.

It also adds support for authenticating to **Redis Sentinel** with its own username and password, distinct from the Redis master's credentials, via the `REDIS_SENTINEL_USERNAME` and `REDIS_SENTINEL_PASSWORD` environment variables.
Check the [changelog](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/client-credentials/changelog) for the full list of changes.

improvements.title: CRUD Service v7.2.7
description: The new versions `v7.2.7` and `v7.2.5` of the _CRUD Service_ are available!
`v7.2.5` introduces the `FASTIFY_PLUGIN_TIMEOUT_MS` environment variable to customize the startup timeout of a Fastify plugin, which helps when the service manages many collections.
`v7.2.7` updates internal libraries to fix vulnerabilities.
Check the [changelog](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/crud-service/changelog) for the full list of changes.

bugFixes.title: JWT Token Validator v1.3.0
description: The new version `v1.3.0` of the _JWT Token Validator_ is available!
JWT payload decoding now uses base64url encoding, fixing spurious `unable decoding JWT payload` errors for claim values containing multi-byte UTF-8 characters (e.g. accented letters).
The `/verify` handler now refreshes the JWKS and retries when the cached keys can't verify the token (e.g. after a key rotation), instead of failing immediately.
Check the [changelog](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/jwt-token-validator/changelog) for the full list of changes.

bugFixes.title: Export Service v2.1.0
description: The new versions `v2.1.0` and `v2.0.2` of the _Export Service_ are available!
The service now sends the `accept: application/x-ndjson` header required by the CRUD Service from version 6.9.0.
It also updates the Node.js Docker image to fix vulnerabilities.
Check the [changelog](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/export-service/changelog) for the full list of changes.

bugFixes.title: Security updates
description: The following Runtime Components have new versions that fix security vulnerabilities: [Files Service v2.10.6](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/files-service/changelog), [Real-Time Updater v7.11.3](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/real-time-updater/changelog), [Single View Creator v6.8.2](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/single-view-creator/changelog), [Swagger Aggregator v3.9.7](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/swagger-aggregator/changelog) and [Timer Service v2.1.5](/docs/runtime-components/plugins/timer-service/changelog).
